notes.title: Wizmans World Re;Try joins Steam Next Fest 2025 June edition!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44805395/bff81912ed6857850f1cf3898406fa0a8e98800f.jpg"][/img]Play demo version of Wizmans World Re;Try at Steam Next Fest 2025 June Edition from June 9th PDT 10 am to June 16th.

WiZmans World Re;Try is HD remaster of legendary JRPG WiZmans World from Jaleco with enhanced 2D pixelated graphic and sound. Experience the vast world of Wizarest with 3 fairly like homunculis.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2214620/WiZmans_World_ReTry/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
